scope.purpose: portable K1 cost model and investment priority; no elimination rule
scope.output_checks: active vector lanes, scalar state, pointer endpoint and guards
scope.tail_limit: inactive agnostic vector lanes are not numerical outputs
scope.memory: random pointer cycle at 64-byte spacing; no inferred physical cache level
scope.profile_scope: CPU 0; warm steady state; vector dependency and independent streams
scope.intervals: replicate variability; not unseen-algorithm prediction confidence

prediction_validation.scope: parameter measurements alone do not prove unseen-kernel accuracy

limits: stream cost includes finite independent-chain limits
vector memory latency is not isolated
no multicore bandwidth or coherence model
measurement ranges are not prediction confidence intervals
